problemheader.main: Most Parents Have No Way Of Knowing If Their Family Car's Tyres Are

problemData.problemPhara:
You drive the kids to school, to sport, to birthday parties. You're on these roads every single day. And somewhere in the back of your mind is a question you can never quite answer: are the tyres okay?

You shouldn't have to guess. But most tyre shops don't make it easy to get a straight answer. Some tell you everything needs replacing when it doesn't. Some wave you through without really checking. Neither gives you the peace of mind you actually need.

amplifyItems.desc: At 100km/h in the rain, a car on worn tyres can take an extra 8+ metres to stop compared to new tyres. That's the difference between safe and not.

amplifyItems.title: Vehicles have at least one tyre that needs attention most owners don't know
amplifyItems.desc: Sidewall cracking, internal damage from kerb hits, and uneven wear aren't visible from a walk around. Only a proper inspection reveals them.

amplifyItems.title: Of vehicles on Perth roads are running on significantly under inflated tyres
amplifyItems.desc: Under inflation causes overheating, uneven wear, and handling instability. It also reduces fuel efficiency by up to 3% per year.

amplifyItems.title: Faster tyre wear when alignment is off tyres that should last 3 years last 1
amplifyItems.desc: One kerb hit or pothole can knock alignment out. The car still drives but the tyres are quietly eating themselves from the inside.

amplifyItems.title: Of tyre failures are preventable with regular inspection and maintenance

faqQAItem1.quection: What does the free safety check actually include?
faqQAItem1.answer: We check all four tyres: tread depth measured with a gauge on every tyre, inflation pressure checked and adjusted, sidewalls inspected for cracking and damage, and wear patterns assessed. We give you a written report of what we found. If everything's fine, we tell you and you drive away no charge, no pressure to buy anything.

faqQAItem1.quection: How do I know I'm getting an honest recommendation and not a sales pitch?
faqQAItem1.answer: We show you the actual gauge readings and point to the specific tyre with the issue. We never recommend replacing all four if only two need it. We won't recommend work you don't need we've built many years of business on Perth families trusting us, and that trust is worth far more than an extra tyre sale.

faqQAItem1.quection: When do tyres actually need replacing how will I know?
faqQAItem1.answer: In WA the legal minimum is 1.5mm tread depth. We recommend replacing at 2–3mm for families because wet braking performance starts degrading before the legal limit. We'll show you the actual measurement and explain exactly where you sit. Signs to watch for between checks: vibration, uneven wear, cracking sidewalls, or a soft tyre that keeps losing pressure.

faqQAItem2.quection: Does the price you quote include everything fitment, balancing, disposal?
faqQAItem2.answer: Yes always. Our prices include the tyre, fitting, wheel balancing, new valve stems, and old tyre disposal. The price we quote is the price you pay. Nothing appears at the counter that wasn't discussed beforehand.

faqQAItem2.quection: Can I bring the kids? How long will it take?
faqQAItem2.answer: Yes bring the kids, we're family friendly. Most standard fitments take 90 minutes while you wait. A free safety check is about 15 minutes. We'll give you a realistic time when you book. You can also drop the car and come back if that suits you better.(Subject to availability)

faqQAItem2.quection: Can I book around school pick up times?
faqQAItem2.answer: Yes. We're open Monday to Friday 8:00am–5:00pm and Saturday 8am–12pm, Sunday Closed. Same day and next day bookings are usually available. Call us and we'll find a time that fits around your schedule including early morning slots before school.

faqQAItem3.quection: We're going on a road trip what should I check before we go?
faqQAItem3.answer: Before any long trip: tread depth, inflation pressure on all four (don't forget the spare), sidewall condition, and the age of the tyres (rubber degrades with age even if tread looks okay). Our free pre trip safety check covers all of this 15 minutes, no charge. We'd rather you go on the trip knowing everything's right.(Subject to availability)

faqQAItem3.quection: I hit a curb pretty hard should I get it checked?
faqQAItem3.answer: Yes absolutely worth getting checked. A hard kerb hit can cause internal tyre damage that isn't visible from outside, and can also knock the wheel alignment out. Both problems are cheap to fix early but potentially serious if ignored. Drive in and we'll take a look free, no obligation.
